title: Role Steering of Language Models for Social Simulations
abstract: arXiv:2608.00023v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Social simulations built from language-model agents need role-conditioned behavior that can be checked before agents are placed into a simulated population. We introduce an activation-steering screening workflow for role-conditioned agents: define a role profile, extract a role-specific direction, sweep four steering coefficients, evaluate role-profile alignment, and pass or flag each candidate configuration. On OLMo-3-7B-Instruct, we apply the workflow to a mixed 275-role inventory with 228 role-agnostic questions, GPT-4.1-mini prompted role references, and GPT-4.1-mini judges. We also introduce CastVectors, which receive higher judged role-profile alignment than an assistant-axis directional control from prior persona-vector work, with mean overall scores of 63.2 versus 41.1 across the tested grid. translated_title: 面向社会模拟的语言模型角色引导
translated_abstract: 由语言模型智能体构建的社会模拟需要在将智能体放入模拟人群之前能够被验证的角色条件化行为。我们提出了一种面向角色条件化智能体的激活引导筛选工作流：定义角色档案、提取角色特定方向、扫描四个引导系数、评估角色档案对齐度，并对每个候选配置进行通过或标记。在 OLMo-3-7B-Instruct 上，我们将该工作流应用于包含 275 个角色的混合角色清单、228 个与角色无关的问题、由 GPT-4.1-mini 提示生成的角色参考以及 GPT-4.1-mini 评判者。我们还提出了 CastVectors，其在评判的角色档案对齐度上优于此前人格向量工作中的助手轴方向控制方法，在测试网格上的平均总分为 63.2 对比 41.1。CastVectors 还保持了较高的词汇多样性，而控制方法在较大系数下词汇多样性急剧下降。角色级筛选是……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种激活引导筛选工作流和新方法 CastVectors，用于为语言模型智能体注入可验证的角色条件化行为，在社会模拟中实现了显著更高的角色档案对齐度（63.2 对比 41.1），同时保持了词汇多样性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces an activation-steering screening workflow and CastVectors, a role-steering method that equips language-model agents with verifiable role-conditioned behavior for social simulations, achieving substantially higher role-profile alignment (63.2 vs. 41.1) while preserving lexical diversity.
